segments.title: Councillor's Concerns on Heritage Property Costs
description: Property owners face 70-80% assessment increases.

Financial incentives are needed to retain heritage buildings.
Suggested looking at federal incentives and heritage districts.

segments.title: Program Changes and Low Heritage Designation
description: Current program incentivizes property changes, not ownership.
Saskatoon has only about 40 designated heritage properties.
Property tax exemption could incentivize ownership.
Education and regulatory review are key improvements.

chips.text: Exemptions could be 40% or 50% of a tax bill.
The best building is a building that's already built.
Heritage property owners

segments.title: Defining Success for Heritage Designation
description: Saskatoon has 40 designated and 30 holding bylaw properties.
Question raised about desired number of recognized properties.
Committee needs to define success metrics for the program.
Staff noted low number compared to other cities.

chips.text: Do we have a sense of what we think we would like to see in terms of recognized properties?

segments.title: Grant Program Effectiveness and Inter-City Comparison
description: TCU Place is not currently designated.
Regina has 104, Calgary 163, Winnipeg 365 heritage properties.
Average grant project cost is low ($3-4k).
Provincial funding is 50% matching, no federal funding.

chips.text: Average grant project cost is low, around $3,000 or $4,000.
Small property owners

segments.title: Insufficient Incentives and Heritage Register Limitations
description: Designation remains a liability for property owners.
Current incentives are not enough for major repairs.
Environmental concerns (asbestos, mold) add to costs.
Heritage register requires owner consent, some decline.

chips.text: Feel good doesn't put money against my mortgage.
Business owners and lenders

segments.title: Promoting Viability Through Heritage Designation
description: Designation should offer more than just a “feel good” aspect.
It needs to help maintain building viability.
Demystification of the process is crucial.
There are upsides to designation that need promotion.

chips.text: Designation really can help them own or keep the viability of that building going.
